items.a: Yes. Everything in the case is solid gold or solid silver. We do not sell gold-filled or gold-plated pieces. We are not affiliated with the brands whose styles we sell.
items.source: Confirmed by Tom, 3 Oct 2026 (questionnaire Q3: all solid).

items.a: Gold, silver and other precious metals, jewellery in any condition including broken pieces and odd earrings, and pre-owned watches. Scrap gold is bought at 94% of the live spot price and silver at 75%; wearable and desirable pieces and watches are worth more, so ask. Bring it into the shop for a price, or send photographs and the weight first.
items.source: Confirmed by Tom, 3 Oct 2026 (questionnaire Q13 rates, Q14 watches and precious metals).

items.q: How do I buy something I have seen?
items.a: Enquire about it by the form, phone or WhatsApp. We confirm it is still in, agree the price, and you collect from the shop or we send it next-day, UK only.
items.source: Tom, 3 Oct 2026 (Q6 enquire-then-sell, Q7 UK next day).

items.a: Bring it in, or send a photo and a rough weight first. It goes on the scale in front of you and you get a price while you wait. Bring photo ID.

items.q: Do I need ID to sell?
items.a: Yes. Bring photo ID when you sell gold, precious metals or a watch.
items.source: Confirmed by Tom, 3 Oct 2026 (questionnaire Q14: photo ID needed).

items.a: Yes. Jewellery repairs and soldering are done in the shop. Bring the piece in, or send a photo for a quote.
items.source: Confirmed by Shaun for Tom, 3 Oct 2026.

items.q: How much does a repair cost?
items.a: It depends on the piece. Bring it in or send a photo and we will tell you what it needs and what it costs.
items.source: Confirmed by Shaun for Tom, 3 Oct 2026.

items.q: How do I know what I am buying?
items.a: Ask. We will tell you the metal, the weight and the size before you buy, and everything we sell is solid gold or silver.

Yes. Every watch we sell is a genuine pre-owned branded watch. Not all of them come with the original box and papers, but we can verify and confirm any watch before you buy. We are not affiliated with the brands we sell.
items.source: Confirmed by Tom, 3 Oct 2026 (questionnaire Q4: genuine, not always boxed, can verify/confirm).

items.q: Can I see a piece before buying?
items.a: Yes. Come to 49 Cambridge Street, Cleethorpes DN35 8HD. Message ahead and we will put it aside and confirm it is still in.
Yes. Next-day delivery is available nationwide, UK only, on pieces bought from the shop. Confirm postage and timing with the shop when you enquire.
items.source: Confirmed by Tom, 3 Oct 2026 (questionnaire Q7: nationwide next day, UK only). Cost, tracking and insurance not given.

items.a: No. The website is a showcase of what we do. Enquire about a piece and the sale is arranged with the shop directly, over the counter or with next-day delivery across the UK.
items.source: Confirmed by Tom, 3 Oct 2026 (questionnaire Q6: no returns policy online, showcase site, enquire-then-sell).

items.a: Yes. Put the value of gold or a watch you already own towards something else in the shop, and we will work out the difference.

items.q: Can you source a piece for me?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the piece you are looking for and we will source it.

items.q: Do you make pieces to order?
items.a: Yes. Tell us what you have in mind and we come back with what is possible and a price.
